Case · PropTech · Lead Qualification
How Mudafy turned a flood of WhatsApp inquiries into a stream of qualified leads, and gave its agents back the hours they spent chasing contacts who were never going to buy.
Leads qualified before the agent
Hundreds of inquiries, lots of noise in the leads

Mudafy receives hundreds of WhatsApp inquiries every month about its property catalog. The problem wasn't a lack of demand: it was the noise: tons of unqualified leads come in, and agents spent hours filtering them by hand.
Agents manually qualified every inquiry, losing hours on warm and cold leads that would never convert.
Qualification depended on the person and the moment. Good leads went cold waiting, and bad ones consumed the same attention.
Inquiries came in at all hours. Without someone available 24/7, prospects with real intent were lost before the first contact.

StudioChat built an AI assistant that follows Mudafy's sales strategy in every WhatsApp conversation: it gets to know the prospect, presents the projects, and decides whether there's a real fit before involving a human.
The assistant follows Mudafy's commercial playbook step by step: it probes, presents projects, and detects fit, always in the brand's voice.
Gets to know the prospect
Presents the projects
Talks through the catalog and the relevant projects based on what each person is looking for, without rigid scripts.
Separates hot, warm, and cold leads so commercial energy goes only where there's real intent.
